function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapFlipRotator
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a FlipRotator structure that contains the given IWICBitmapFlipRotator interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapFlipRotator interface

function.return_type: FlipRotator*. It represents a pointer to a FlipRotator structure that contains the given IWICBitmapFlipRotator interface.

function.name: FlipRotator_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: If the interface is supported, this will point to that interface after the function call.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if it is not, and E_INVALIDARG if the ppv parameter is NULL.

function.name: FlipRotator_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the FlipRotator object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the FlipRotator object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: FlipRotator_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a FlipRotator object. It decrements the reference count and if it reaches zero, it deletes the critical section, releases the bitmap source if it exists, and frees the memory allocated for the FlipRotator object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the FlipRotator object to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation

function.name: FlipRotator_GetSize
function.description: This function gets the size of the FlipRotator object. If the 'swap_xy' attribute of the object is true, it swaps the width and height values.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICBitmapFlipRotator

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to store the width of the FlipRotator object

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to store the height of the FlipRotator object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source of the FlipRotator object is not set, otherwise it returns the result of IWICBitmapSource_GetSize function call

function.name: FlipRotator_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of the source bitmap flip rotator.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the bitmap flip rotator.

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the pixel format of the source bitmap.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source is not available, otherwise it returns the pixel format of the source bitmap.

function.name: FlipRotator_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of a bitmap flip rotator. If the source is not available, it returns an error. If the swap_xy flag is set, it swaps the X and Y parameters.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap flip rotator

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to store the X resolution

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to store the Y resolution

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source is not available. Otherwise, it returns the result of IWICBitmapSource_GetResolution function call.

function.name: FlipRotator_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the palette from the source to the given palette. If the source is not available, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICBitmapFlipRotator from which the palette is to be copied.

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICPalette where the copied palette will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the source is not available, otherwise it returns the status of the palette copy operation.

function.name: FlipRotator_CopyPixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a source to a destination, with the ability to flip and rotate the pixels.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the bitmap flip rotator

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that defines the portion of the source bitmap to copy

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the bitmap. This is the number of bytes from one row of pixels in memory to the next row of pixels in memory

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: The size of the buffer to receive the pixels

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to receive the pixels

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns standard HRESULT error codes.

function.name: FlipRotator_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a FlipRotator object, setting the rotation and flip options based on the provided parameters. It also locks the object during the operation to prevent other threads from accessing it simultaneously.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the FlipRotator object to be initialized.

parameters.name: pISource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options for transforming the bitmap, such as rotation and flipping.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and an error code if it fails.

function.name: FlipRotator_Create
function.description: This function initializes a FlipRotator object, sets its properties to default values, and assigns it to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: fliprotator
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICBitmapFlipRotator object. The function will assign the address of the newly created FlipRotator object to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the memory allocation for the new FlipRotator object fails.
